title: Back to the Features: DINO as a Foundation for Video World Models
author: Federico Baldassarre; Marc Szafraniec; Basile Terver; Vasil Khalidov; Francisco Massa; Yann LeCun; Patrick Labatut; Maximilian Seitzer; Piotr Bojanowski
summary: DINO-world is a video world model that predicts future video features using a frozen DINOv2 encoder. It learns from large, unlabeled video datasets to understand how scenes change over time. This model can also be fine-tuned with action data to improve predictions in different environments.
